header.title: Portfolio exposures
header.subtitle: Weights, concentration (top 1 and top 5) and exposure by sector and position, with the alerts and the threshold that triggers them.

methodology.title: Scope and limits
methodology.noRiskMeasures: This page does not calculate volatility, drawdown or VaR: those measures live in Portfolio intelligence.
methodology.detailPre: For per-position detail, see the portfolio. For volatility, drawdown, VaR and measured performance,

thresholds.t20: 20% threshold of portfolio value: above it, a single position concentrates the risk. A concentration rule, not a VaR or a probability of loss.
thresholds.t10: 10% threshold for pre-FCF companies (not yet generating free cash flow): twice as strict as the general 20%.
thresholds.t0: The cash in this currency is negative (debit balance). Review the balances or the trades in that currency; the threshold is not falling below zero.
thresholds.generic: Alert triggered by exceeding the threshold shown next to the measured value.

values.valuationDatesDiffer: Positions and cash as of different dates: the total combines both

alerts.title: Concentration and liquidity alerts
alerts.emptyOk: No concentration or liquidity alerts in the calculated data.
alerts.emptyIncomplete: No alerts in the available data. Incomplete coverage cannot rule out alerts in the rest of the portfolio.
